title: Plywood / Sheathing Backing
short_answer: Backing goes in before board — cabinets, grab bars, and TV mounts need specified plywood, not hope.
plain_words: Blocking is one stud bay. Plywood backing is a panel so something can land anywhere on that wall. Install what the drawings / packet call for, flush or recessed as detailed, and stop if the wall is rated and the listing does not allow random plywood.
when_to_use: Fixture zones, cabinets, grab bars, TV mounts
prerequisites: Read drawings and finish schedule before acting

steps.body: scope / Job Start / drawings. Plywood for mounts is easy to "just add" as free work.
